assumptions.foreground_work: YUV display reads at panel refresh plus candidate 30fps YUV source writes; excludes unrelated traffic

checks.note: opaque HUD composition modeled conservatively: YUV is still fetched under HUD; HUD reads counted separately

mapping.bl8: 8 x16 words = 16 wire bytes; tag = physical_word_address >> 3
mapping.chroma: bilinear 4-neighbor interpolation; exact 1/2/4 neighbor accesses based on odd u/v; final neighbor clamps to 359/239
mapping.placement: physical x=0..479 maps v; physical y=40..759 maps u=physical_y-40; outside active image black
mapping.tile: 8x8 u8 samples, row-major in-tile, packed two samples per x16 word; 32 words/tile

scope: deterministic physical-address/cache traffic and schedulability estimate only; no exact-pixel, RTL, physical timing, or FPS proof

traffic.chroma_fetch_policy: normative parity count (1/2/4); sum is 2.25 samples per component/output pixel
